facadeModelId.description: Registered facade GLB (facades/models.json) that owns this frontage's street face. The kit keeps the wall mass, roof edge and collision and drops its face modules. Superseded by zones[].sectionModelId, which owns every face of a zone.

sectionModelId.description: Registered section GLB (facades/models.json) that owns every visible face of this zone. Mounted at the rect's south-west corner on the zone floor; the kit keeps wall mass, roofs and collision and drops its face modules for the zone.

sectionFaces.description: Zone faces the section GLB owns (default all four). The kit keeps its face details on the other faces, so a builder can rework one wall without stripping the rest.
